listing.name: Heggie Tales v0.6.8
listing.summary: Formerly known Tales from the Hegemony is an old? and very lore friendly Quest mod! - It introduces the player into the world of the Hegemony and it's noble houses. Do not expect flashy ships or AI, but realistic people living in a crapsack universe.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a quest mod featuring over 22,500 words of lore expansion, unique ship variants, and integration with other mods.

description:
v0.6.8d

A Quest Mod!

Formerly known Tales from the Hegemony

Download

requires

LazyLib 2.8

or later

requires

MagicLib 1.1.3

or later

All updates are

SHOULD BE

savegame-compatible (But not if TOLD!)

Github Link! • Previous Versions!

To start the storyline, check Jangala's bar!

You will GRIND reputation!

Features

- Over 22,500+ words.

- Expansion of some lore of the Hegemony. (Nothing lore breaking I hope!)

- A unique XIV Ship Variant.

-

No anime

.

- Hegemony, Pather and Pirate Contacts!

- A unique Hegemony Officer

- A way to stop AI inspections without blowing half of the Hegemony Navy.

-

No anime

.

- One Somewhat IMPOSSIBLE mission!

- Small integration with other famous mods. Such as PAGSM!!!

Quests

(So far)

All Quests are 'Easy' in the sense there are no wacky AI enemies. 
Just... Life.

- 1 Very simple and short quest made for learning.

- 2 Somewhat medium sized Quests about helping an Eventide Family.

The Unique Ship:

Spoiler

It's on the banner of the mod.

Spoiler[close][close]

Changelog:

SpoilerVersión 0.6.8C

- Thanks to whoever JamesTripleQ is on GitHub.

- I AM STILL STANDING!!!

- Perhaps more stuff in the future, idk.

- Localization and rules.csv Rework thanks to PROM!

Versión 0.6.7

- Added PAGSM references to the Singular Scenario!

- Removes some Knights of Ludd stuff that was breaking.

Version 0.6.6

- Added a new nexerelin Custom Start! You need to beat the 'Loyal to the End' mission!

- In this start you begin with a Retaliation-Class battleship, in a commission with the Hegemony and you need to speak with Borealis in Eventide to unlock Hannah and Australis!

- Misc grammar fixes.

- More

PAGSM

references! If you have the mod enabled, of course!

- Salt gets a

Knights of Ludd

capital ship if you have the mod enabled!

Versión 0.6.5

- The mod can ADDED MID GAME but not REMOVED.

- Sindrian Commission bad.

- Unique Mission is extra hard if SWP is added. (More Easter Eggs)

- Fixed Some stuff I forgot.

Versión 0.6.2

- The name change! Also, some grammar fixes

Versión 0.6.1

- Released the mod, I guess?

[close]

Thankies and Credits

My Discord server for hearing my ramblings.

Prom for actually reading and helping me with the localization/proofreading.

JamesTripleQ for forking my mod and making me realize I had made a Starsector mod years ago.

Timid for helping with me with code and Iron Shell stuff.

Selkie for allowing me to use Iron Shell parts.

Alex for making this awesome game.

toopok4k3 for his Osiris Alliance mod that made me understand how quests work.

Wisp for letting me steal the post style.

And of course, David for making the fun art and lore!

"AI" Generated Content

- The NPC portraits were created using SeverianVoid's LoRa, the new version and the old version,

Kitbashing and mixing with some art of mine from another game and editing it all with vanilla stuff and my own photoshop skills!

PD: English is not my first language.

Link to my kofi!

Tell me if something breaks because I have no clue what I am doing!
